items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Because that's the first time I've ever seen Al Capone.

ctx.x: So we worked down there a while, then after that we got out of there, there was so much trouble down there, we lose that job, we close the place up I think. Yeah, there's some shooting on there. Yeah, there's some gangsters there. Yeah, there's some gangsters, that's right. Because that's the first time I've ever seen Al Capone. Yeah, he used to come up there to gang all the time. So after that closed up, somehow Oliver got in touch with working over at Lincoln Garden, it was the Royal Garden there. See. So we…
